annotations.text:
One system, two surface scales.

Marketing runs on the dark ground; the app stays light because it is data-dense and read all day. The dark sidebar is the bridge between them.

Red stays reserved for danger, warning and success — the brand hue never enters it.

Per-vertical accent.

Each solutions page sets one accent token — real estate is blue here. Six industries get six identities with no new components, and the halo and button ink derive from the accent so a swap stays coherent.

Try the swatches on the artboard's tweak row.

The app screens.

Dashboard and Wallet are what a client sees. Client detail is ours — the screen that makes reselling operable: rate against supplier cost, margin, which cloud it runs in, and whether upstream usage reconciled.

All three now show one consistent set of books: 3,500 min bought, 1,360 used, 2,140 left; 1,284 min over 30 days at ₹5.00.
